title: Traditional Polish Yeast Galette
description: A classic Polish dessert featuring a flaky yeast dough and topped with a sweet, buttery filling.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the yeast and warm water. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes until it becomes frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and sugar.
Add the yeast mixture to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add the melted butter and egg, and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours, or until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a circle that is about 1/4 inch thick.
Transfer the dough to a greased baking sheet and spread the sugar evenly over the dough.
Bake the galette for 20-25 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
Remove the galette from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
